research.searchCoverage: Official PDF.co REST API at https://api.pdf.co/v1 with x-api-key authentication, GET /v1/account/credit/balance, POST /v1/pdf/info, HTTP 200 error boolean, ByteScout/Artifex US identity, ePapyrus 2023 acquisition, and dated incident search (PDF.co / ByteScout + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. Unrelated PDF Pro/Help PDF S3 leak and AppSuite PDF Editor malware are different products. No qualifying PDF.co API platform compromise was identified. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

selection.ownership: Artifex Software, Inc. d/b/a ByteScout and PDF.co (Wilmington, DE / San Francisco, CA, United States). Acquired by ePapyrus in 2023; this recipe is the global api.pdf.co edition, not a mainland-China product.

research.edition: international PDF.co Web API at api.pdf.co
research.searchCoverage: PDF.co Web API is GET/POST https://api.pdf.co/v1 with x-api-key. GET /v1/account/credit/balance is the documented remaining-credits probe and healthcheck. POST /v1/pdf/info is the origin metadata read. This recipe now covers the live Composio PDF_CO toolkit (49 HTTP tools) plus healthcheck: conversion, merge, split, compress v2, document parser, barcode generate, file upload, and job check. HTTP 200 bodies with error:true are demoted via bodyErrorPaths [error]. status is not used because a numeric 200 or job status success would be treated as an error. Operator is Artifex/ByteScout in the United States (ePapyrus acquired ByteScout in 2023). Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /v1/account/credit/balance, the documented remaining-credits probe. It is not a conversion or search.

HTTP 200 bodies with error:true are demoted via bodyErrorPaths [error]. status is not used because a numeric 200 would be treated as an error.

Maps to documented POST /v1/pdf/info. url is required. Optional password, timeout, and expiration are forwarded when present.
Always sends async:false matching the pinned source and the official example payload. HTTP username/password, profiles, and callback are omitted.
This endpoint costs credits and is not used as healthcheck. Conversion endpoints that fan out to transit files are omitted.
HTTP 200 bodies with error:true are connector errors via bodyErrorPaths. Returns raw PDF.co JSON under data rather than the source pageCount/title/raw wrapper.
